integrity_statement: All infinite statements have symbolic geometric proofs; the finite checker is illustrative and is not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Special discrete parameter family and its exterior foliated annulus only; no generic-parameter mixing or central-region statements. The polygon geometry and foliation are taken from the cited published theorem; the new result is the quantitative area law and rotation-speed distribution.
title: Exact slow-winding area law for the integrable Ostrovski square maps
